{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('Number of -1 in customer_age:', (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print('QA orders found:', len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print('Refunded orders:', len(refunded_orders))

# Check if revenue is really numeric
print('Unique revenue values:', sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
